verdict.rationale: Supabase Auth documents MFA for application users, using TOTP authenticator apps and phone messaging, with enrollment, challenge and verify flows plus app-level enforcement guidance. It also documents enterprise SAML 2.0 SSO for project end-users with Okta, Google Workspace, Entra/AD and other identity providers. Missing for 10: evidence of enterprise OIDC SSO (only SAML is documented), explicit documentation of mandating SSO (not just offering it) for a domain or tenant, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
